sloka: सर्व दिव्य अस्त्र योक्तारम् यज्ञ विघ्न करम् सदा ।पुरीम् भोगवतीम् गत्वा पराजित्य च वासुकिम् ॥३-३२-१३॥
transliteration: sarva divya astra yoktāram yajña vighna karam sadā ।purīm bhogavatīm gatvā parājitya ca vāsukim ॥3-32-13॥

translations.english: He who could employ all divine weapons, disrupt sacrifices, had gone to the city of Bhogavati, defeated Vasuki and abducted the dear wife of Takshaka.
translations.hindi: हे अकम्पन ! तू यह तो वतला कि, क्या बह राम देवराज इन्द्र और सब देवताओं को साथ ले, जनस्थान में आया है ?
